_comment: Per-route payload ledger. Enforced by scripts/check-route-budget.mjs in the docs build (blocking in CI via docs-build). Fails when a route EXCEEDS its budget and when it drops far enough below that the budget has gone stale — see that script's header, and engineering/decisions/2026-08-17-studio-dynamic-loading-audit.md §9.7. COVERS ALL FIVE ROUTES perf-nightly.yml measures, as of 2026-09-05: the three content routes joined when `script-size` was deleted from that nightly for measuring what happened to LOAD rather than what the build produced (35% of 150 repeat readings of an IDENTICAL commit moved past its own 3% tolerance, worst 106KB on a ~200KB page). See engineering/decisions/2026-09-02-alarm-channel-saturation.md.
_units: bytes. eagerJsGz = gzip(level 6) of every /_astro/*.js referenced in the route's HTML. htmlRaw = the HTML document itself. Budgets carry ~3% headroom above the measured build; the gate also fails if a route drops more than 5% BELOW its budget, which means the number here is stale and must be ratcheted down.

studio._eagerJsGzNote: 654175 -> 674500 (2026-09-06): the Studio gained a FOURTH Fabricate faculty. Measured exactly, by building this route twice on one machine with one toolchain: 650964 bytes gz on `main` (8dbb339), 653952 with this branch — +2988, chunk count unchanged at 82. The growth is +3617 in the eager `StudioIsland` (the Library's Motions card, the Fabricate tab, the StudioShell wiring); the faculty itself is behind the same lazy boundary its three siblings use, and its chunk REPLACES the retired Motion tab's `scene-library` almost exactly (25723 -> 25101, a -622 wash). Not given back, because what remains is UI that has to exist when the Studio boots: deferring the Library's Motions card would lazy-load part of the Library and slow its first open. What COULD be given back already was — `Library.tsx` loads `motion/skeleton` (and through it the intake kernel and DOMPurify) on the Insert click rather than with the route, measured -717 bytes. TWO THINGS WORTH KNOWING FOR THE NEXT PERSON. First, this gate reads ~900 bytes HIGHER in CI than in the cloud sandbox on the same commit (653952 local vs 639.5KB in CI on 285246e) — minified output differs slightly by toolchain, so a local pass with under ~1KB of headroom is NOT evidence CI will pass, and CI is the authority. This branch sat 223 bytes under the old budget locally and 673 over it in CI. Second, that is why the number is set from the CI measurement + ~3% per _units above, not from the local one. See PR #2081. PRIOR: 659985 -> 654175 (2026-08-23): `architect-model.js` — the AI provider layer (OAuth, the model ladder, the streaming client, the catalog cache) — left the eager bundle. `WorkspaceSheet` statically imported it for ONE synchronous predicate, `orSupportsCache`, which now lives in its own dependency-free `ai/or-cache.js`; every other reach is already `architect.ts`'s dynamic import(), so the provider layer is now its own on-demand chunk (15.8KB raw / 6.1KB gz) instead of being inlined into the monolith. Measured -5.6KB gz / -16.0KB raw (640868 -> 635121 bytes gz), same machine, chunk count unchanged at 57. Set to measured + ~3% per _units above. See #1773 and engineering/decisions/2026-08-23-studio-shell-decomposition.md §5.2.
studio._htmlRawNote: 201600 -> 208400 (2026-09-16): `split-panel` gained a capacity contract, and the Studio inlines the component catalog, so the block ships in this route's HTML. The SAME cause as the 2026-09-01 entry below, which raised this number for three other components' capacity blocks. Measured exactly, by building this route twice off one tree: 201433 bytes with main's manifest, 202290 with this one — +857, all of it this change. Two things are in that 857: the `capacity` + `adapt.capacity` blocks, and the stress specimen going from three items to five, which the gallery-contract `band` rule requires once the real ceiling is declared. NOT GIVEN BACK, because giving it back means under-declaring `hard` to 3 so the old three-item specimen conforms — and a five-item panel measurably fits at 16:9 (tools/calibrate-capacity.js: ceiling 5, overflows at 6), so that would warn on a slide that is fine. The prose note in the capacity block WAS given back, from ~600 chars to 340: the reasoning belongs in the PR, not in the bundle every Studio visitor downloads. WORTH KNOWING, and it is the `components` entry's lesson repeating: main measured 201433 against this 201600 budget — 167 bytes of headroom, 0.08%, where this file specifies ~3%. The room was spent by changes that each fit inside the 3% and none of which this PR made, so the change that found the wall is not the change that spent it. Set to measured + ~3% per _units above. PRIOR: 192800 -> 201600 (2026-09-06): the pre-paint shell gained the editor toolbar it had been missing. It drew ONE placeholder pill where the hydrated app draws eleven controls (Add slide, Reshape slide, Fix all issues, Version history, Slide settings, the Markdown/Compose segment, Collapse editor) plus the preview bar's step buttons and a real Reader-view trigger, so the whole band under the header filled in and GREW at hand-off. Those controls' inline lucide glyphs are the bytes. It spends more than the duplicate tail this same PR deleted gave back: measured 195679 on this tree, against 187218 with the tail deleted and the toolbar still missing — so this PR is net +8461 bytes on the route, not the -6182 the previous ratchet recorded. Both numbers are same-tree measurements from the docs build; the pre-PR figure was not re-measured here. Set to measured + ~3% per _units above. See engineering/decisions/2026-09-05-studio-one-header.md. PRIOR: 199200 -> 192800 (2026-09-05): the pre-paint shell lost a whole duplicate header tail. It drew TWO of them — one for the desktop Read/Write "slim" header and one for Craft — because the app itself rendered two headers; the app renders one now, so the shell draws one, and the second tail's inline lucide glyphs (search, theme, mode, tours, Present, Share, feedback, menu) plus the Read-only deck-title twin left the document. Measured 187218 bytes on this tree. Set to measured + ~3% per _units above. See engineering/decisions/2026-09-05-studio-one-header.md. PRIOR: 192900 -> 199200 (2026-09-01): auto-split enrolled `content`, `list-criteria` and `journey`, and the Studio inlines the component catalog, so their three new `capacity` blocks ship in this route's HTML. Measured exactly, by building this route twice off one tree: 192397 bytes with main's manifests, 193414 with these — +1017, all of it the three blocks, nothing else in the change reaching this route. Not given back, because giving it back means un-enrolling the components: `content` is the commonest slide in any deck and could not split at all. Set to measured + ~3% per _units above. See engineering/decisions/2026-09-01-autosplit-splits-on-structure.md. PRIOR: 185400 -> 192900 (2026-08-19), the pre-paint shell's Craft activity rail filled with the app's own launchers (7.3KB of inline lucide glyphs); see 2026-08-09-studio-shell-structural-completeness.md.

Measured twice off one tree: 506710 bytes with the component moved aside, 510902 with it present — +4192, the manifest only (this route shows the summary, not the docs body, which is why it costs ~60% of what the components route does). Not given back, because giving it back means shipping the components without the authoring contract this route exists to carry. Set to measured + ~3% per _units above. See engineering/decisions/2026-09-06-cartesian-chart-expansion.md.

components._htmlRawNote: 522800 -> 538600 (2026-09-13): one new chart component, `heatmap`. This route inlines the WHOLE component catalog, so it carries the component's full docs body — slots table, variants, when to use, anti-patterns, common mistakes — not just the manifest summary the playground shows. Measured the same way as the entry below, twice off one tree: 515970 bytes with `lib/components/chart/heatmap` moved aside, 522867 with it present — +6897, right on the ~7KB-per-component rate the Cartesian seven set. Not given back, because giving it back means shipping the component without the authoring contract this route exists to carry. Set to measured + ~3% per _units above. WORTH KNOWING: 6897 bytes blew a budget that nominally had ~15KB of headroom, because most of that headroom was already spent. The route measured 507617 when the budget below was set (2026-09-06) and measures 515970 today WITHOUT this component — so ~8.4KB arrived in between, from changes that each fit inside the 3% and none of which this PR made. A budget with 3% headroom absorbs drift silently until one change finds the wall, and the change that finds it is not the one that spent the room. Unlike eagerJsGz, this metric does NOT drift by toolchain: the local build reads 522867 and CI reported the same 510.6KB, so a local measurement is authoritative here. This route inlines the WHOLE component catalog, so it carries each one's full docs body — slots table, variants, when to use, anti-patterns, common mistakes — not just the manifest summary the playground shows. Measured the same way, twice off one tree: 458670 bytes with the seven moved aside, 507617 with them present — +48947, about 7KB per component. Set to measured + ~3% per _units above.
